title: Senior Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform)
text:
Demo Co. Pine is an agency building fitness apps. We are looking for a senior-level Mobile Developer (Kotlin Multiplatform) to join our mobile team. Work is on-site in our Northhaven office.

Our stack: swift. You will build offline-first features, ship features end to end and review code with the team.

A yearly learning budget. You will mentor less experienced colleagues.
